Newer on this device: %1$d · newer on the server: %2$d · not clear from the times: %3$d
Every choice keeps a safety copy of what it replaces. With the newest of each, saves whose times do not say which is newer stay in the list below for you to decide.
Pick your storage once and Valkyr looks in the places emulators are known to keep their saves (DraStic, Pizza Boy, DuckStation, PPSSPP, Dolphin). You see what was found before anything is added.
Untick what should stay out. You can remove a folder again later; nothing in it is changed by adding it.

No emulator folder was recognised here. Many emulators keep their saves in Android/data, which Android closes to other apps: point the emulator at a folder on shared storage, or add its folder by hand with the row below.
